_comment: Reference config for the ICMP carrier optimised for longevity against behavioural
IP blacklisting (Iran-style DPI). Copy to BOTH servers, change only role, peer,
local_ip and peer_ip. The tunnel rides in ping payloads: there are no ports,
obfs must stay "none" (a QUIC header inside an echo request is not cover, it is the
one anomalous thing about an otherwise ordinary packet), and port hopping does not
apply. The service needs CAP_NET_RAW, and ICMP echo has to be allowed inbound in the
Key longevity knobs (already set to recommended values):
rate_mbps      — hard shape the carrier; unlimited volume is the #1 trigger for IP blocks
keepalive      — longer + jittered; 25s is too chatty for multi-day survival
pad_max        — larger random padding breaks the full-MTU + tiny-ACK size signature
mtu            — modestly below path MTU so packets look less like a bulk tunnel
id_pool / rotate / mimic_ping — identity rotation + real-ping disguise (must match both ends)
Everything under "icmp" above the blank line is local to one host and may differ
between the two servers. Everything below it changes the packets on the wire and is
not negotiated: a mismatch means every packet fails to authenticate.
